# (Retired — split into two templates)

This single combined template has been superseded by the two-`AGENTS.md`-per-scope convention
(outer + inner). Use these instead:

- [`session-root-context-template.md`](session-root-context-template.md) — OUTER, thin pointer, for
  `__untracked_stuff/<scope>/AGENTS.md`.
- [`session-wiki-context-template.md`](session-wiki-context-template.md) — INNER, detailed, for
  `__untracked_stuff/<scope>/session-wiki/AGENTS.md`.

See [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md) § "Two `AGENTS.md` files per scope" for why the split exists.
